page.overview:
Who is "Stone Cold" Steve Austin?

"Stone Cold" Steve Austin (born December 18, 1964 in Austin, Texas) is an American wrestler and actor.

A reference to him was made in Simpsons Bible Stories, with David vs Goliath 2 being held "Stone Cold."

He was "Time Traveler #1" in The Poke of Zorro.
